items.content: Re-read design doc §8.11.36-37 + Lüscher mechanism analysis (§8.11.33-35)
Read key infrastructure lemmas in PeterWeyl.lean (plaquetteBoltzmannPD, characterOrthogonality, triple_product_character_matrix_integral, plaquette_product_separable_decomp)
Read the weakened transferMatrixPositivity_axiom + surrounding context in ReflectionPositivity.lean
Read character_expansion_nonneg_shared (step 2, already proven) to understand its exact statement
Understand the interface Boltzmann factor J structure (S_int, temporal links)

KEY ANALYSIS: interface_kernel_character_expansion gives ∑_w F(w)·Φ_w(U⁺)·Ψ_w(u⁰)·conj(Φ_w(V⁺)) with F≥0. But U⁺ uses w(l), V⁺ uses dual(w(l)) — DIFFERENT char indices. conj(χ_dual) = χ_w (hdual), so V⁺ part = ∏_{L_V} χ_{w(l)}. MISMATCH with character_expansion_nonneg_shared (needs SAME Φ for x,y). Need to determine if L_U=L_V and find correct positivity lemma.

CRITICAL FINDING: L_U=interfaceLinkPos (signedTime>0), L_V=interfaceLinkNeg (signedTime<0) are DIFFERENT link sets (positive vs negative time sites). charFactorPos uses U⁺ at positive sites, charFactorNeg uses U⁻ at negative sites with dual(w). After change of vars V⁺=reflect(U⁻), the V⁺ integral uses charFactorNeg(reflectPosToNeg V⁺) with dual(w). fourierCoeffPos = ∫_{U⁺} ψ·exp(-βS⁺/2)·charFactorPos(w,U⁺) dμ⁺. fourierCoeffNeg = ∫_{V⁺} ψ(σ(u⁰))·exp(-βS⁺/2)·star(charFactorNeg(dual w, reflectPosToNeg V⁺)) dμ⁺. KEY: after step 1 (σ disappears from g), fourierCoeffNeg uses ψ(σ(u⁰))=ψ(u⁰) (no σ twist in g). But charFactorNeg still uses dual(w).

NEXT: Determine the correct positivity approach. The fullReflect form (PROVEN) is: ofReal(∫ψ·Tψ) = C·∑_w F(w)·∫_{u⁰} charFactorInt(w,u⁰)·fourierCoeffPos(w*,σ(u⁰))·fourierCoeffPos(w,u⁰) dμ⁰. After step 1 (σ disappears from g): fourierCoeffPos(w*,σ(u⁰)) = fourierCoeffPos(w*,u⁰) (since g(σ(u⁰))=g(u⁰)). So the form becomes C·∑_w F(w)·∫ charFactorInt(w,u⁰)·A_{w*}(u⁰)·A_w(u⁰) dμ⁰ where A_w=fourierCoeffPos. Need to show this ≥ 0.
